name: AutoVRse - Standard Industry Modules
summary:
AutoVRse builds VR training for industrial workforces. This app opens up a set of those modules so you can try them yourself.

Each one is a real procedure rebuilt in VR. The equipment behaves the way it does on the floor, the steps follow an actual work instruction, and you learn by doing rather than watching a video.

WHAT YOU CAN TRY

Steel plant: carry out a furnace lancing operation in a live shop floor environment
Warehouse logistics: diagnose and replace a flat belt on a package sorting line
